test.query: SELECT max(length(r.s1)) FROM (SELECT toString(number % 50000000) AS s1, toString(number % 50000000) AS s2 FROM numbers_mt(1e7)) AS l INNER JOIN (SELECT toString(number) AS s1, toString(number) AS s2 FROM numbers_mt(5e6)) AS r ON l.s1 = r.s1 AND l.s2 = r.s2 FORMAT Null

SELECT max(length(r.s1)) FROM (SELECT toString(number % 10000000) AS s1, toString(number % 10000000) AS s2 FROM numbers_mt(1e7)) AS l INNER JOIN (SELECT toString(number) AS s1, toString(number) AS s2 FROM numbers_mt(1e6)) AS r ON l.s1 = r.s1 AND l.s2 = r.s2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash'

SELECT max(r.k1) FROM (SELECT number % 50000000 AS k1, number % 50000000 + 1 AS k2, number % 50000000 + 2 AS k3, number % 50000000 + 3 AS k4, number % 50000000 + 4 AS k5 FROM numbers_mt(1e7)) AS l INNER JOIN (SELECT number AS k1, number + 1 AS k2, number + 2 AS k3, number + 3 AS k4, number + 4 AS k5 FROM numbers_mt(5e6)) AS r ON l.k1 = r.k1 AND l.k2 = r.k2 AND l.k3 = r.k3 AND l.k4 = r.k4 AND l.k5 = r.k5 FORMAT Null

SELECT max(r.i) FROM (SELECT number % 10000000 AS i, toString(number % 10000000) AS s FROM numbers_mt(1e7)) AS l INNER JOIN (SELECT number AS i, toString(number) AS s FROM numbers_mt(1e6)) AS r ON l.i = r.i OR l.s = r.s FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM numbers_mt(1e7) WHERE (number % 50000000, toString(number % 50000000)) IN (SELECT number, toString(number) FROM numbers_mt(5e6)) FORMAT Null
